source_note: Built from the official trophy descriptions and the roadmaps published by PowerPyx and Push Square. Times are their estimates, not promises.

stages.blurb: Play the five chapters at your own pace. The story trophies all pop on their own, but three habits during this stage save hours later: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, scan every new vehicle and location with WAiNK, and take optional missions as they appear.
do: Do the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia the morning after Down to Earth — the one possibly missable trophy (see the Missables tab).
Take optional missions as they appear. The 100% checklist needs any 100 of them, out of several hundred.
Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app. The checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles.
Study new animals through the binoculars. The checklist needs 100 of 255 — you do not have to hunt them.
Turn on progress and criminal profile notifications in the UI settings, so you can see what counts.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. There are 15 manual slots and no mission replay.
stages.name: Story first, with good habits

sources.label: Push Square trophy guide — play the story at your leisure, then clean up

stages.blurb: After the credits, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress from the story already counts. PowerPyx calls it lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but the rows that need everything (robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests) are the long pole.
do: Clear the rows that need everything first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 Payday Loan jobs, 8 vaults, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting range golds, 42 drone time trials, 15 Bret target decks.

Then the partial rows: 100 optional tasks, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick-ups, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals.
Fence the totals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills, $200,000 vehicles.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the 10 hardest.

Earning A Long Road here also finishes most of the grind trophies (Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, One Last Thing, Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control, Dime on the Dollar).
stages.name: The 100% checklist

stages.blurb: Most trophies should be done by now. Strangers & Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so finish the 8 stranger strands here, then sweep up whatever is left — the unconfirmed free-roam trophies and the platinum itself.
do: Finish 8 stranger mission strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret, Cal and the rest).
Sweep the free-roam trophies: Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Ten Pin.
Check the tracker for anything left, earn it, and the platinum pops.

warnings.item: The Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent
